messages:
sara_sales: Heads-upprospect (large payments co) emailed RFP: wants BYO-HSM POC with offline key ceremony, split KEK across two custodians, quarterly rotations, and audit mapping for SOX. Can we do offline ceremony in a 3-week POC?
luke_se: Yes, POC with manual ceremony is supported. We need their KMS blobs and root certs ahead of time. Offline ceremony will be a documented runbook + operator tasks.
priya_sec: Security checklist: no plaintext export, dual-custodian signing for import, attestations required (FIPS 140-2/3 L3 + vendor CA attestation). Ask customer for required evidence type and who will perform custodian ops.
emma_ops: Ops note: split-KEK handled by our envelope wrapping flow. We'll create KEK shards and accept encrypted import files. Rotation 'quarterly' ok but recommend rolling rotations (versioned KEK) to avoid mass cache invalidation. Sessions may need reconnect; token caches should be soft-expiry aware.
sara_sales: pricing Q: they want a price for 3-week POC with 4 HSMs (multi-region mirror) and 2 on-call SREs during key ceremony window. Ballpark? :money_with_wings: 
luke_se: For POC we typically bill a POC setup fee + HSM attach at an hourly or daily rate. Add a flat engineer support day rate for ceremony windows. I'll draft numbers.
emma_ops: I'll add an ops SOW line: 2 days of on-call support for ceremony + smoke tests, plus hourly HSM runtime. Also include runbook delivery and a dry-run.
priya_sec: Also they asked about rotation downtime: with staggered KEK promotion and rewrap-on-read we can achieve near-zero downtime. If their app holds long-lived DB connections expecting single key id, they'll need a short reconnect or client lib patch. Recommend we provide client-side snippet for rewrap handshake.
luke_se: client code sample for graceful rotate:
```
# pseudo flow
current = kms.get_key_id()
new = kms.rotate_key(current)
app.cache.on_write(lambda k,v: if k.id==current: rewrap(v,new))
```
priya_sec: compliance ask: provide CSV mapping of KMS API calls to their audit events (encrypt/decrypt/import/rotate). I'll produce that mapping doc and a sample SIEM JSON event.
emma_ops: manual ceremony CLI snippet (for runbook):
```
redwood-ops key-ceremony start --mode offline --participants "alice@cust, bob@cust" \
  --shards 2 --output /secure/ceremony/pack.enc
# operator verifies signatures, uploads pack to HSM attach point
```
infra-bot: Created ticket POC-4477 and linked runbook template :white_check_mark:
sara_sales: Next steps: i'll ask customer for custodian contact, expected rotation cadence confirmation, and whether they need FIPS L3 attestation PDF. I'll post their answer here later. Thanks team :pray:
